topic: Buying cheap boots every winter vs one quality pair resoled for a decade, cost per wear (Ivan vs Isadora)

scenes.narration: Cheap boots cost the most over ten years. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym holding up a cheap boot with a split sole and a sturdy leather boot, comic burst banner reads COST PER WEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ivan and Isadora both need winter boots for a long commute.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man ivan and woman isadora standing in snow with worn out shoes, a bus stop sign, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ivan grabs a forty dollar pair from the discount rack.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man ivan grabbing boots from a discount rack, a price tag reads FORTY DOLLARS, a sign reads CLEARANCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The soles split by February. He buys another pair.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a boot with a split flapping sole in slush, a calendar reads FEBRUARY, man ivan groaning, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two pairs a year, every year, and a closet full of trash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a closet overflowing with broken boots spilling into a trash bin, motion lines, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years later he has spent eight hundred dollars on boots.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a treadmill display reading EIGHT HUNDRED DOLLARS, a mountain of twenty dead boots behind man ivan, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Isadora saves for two months and buys one two hundred dollar pair.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman isadora at a boot shop counter with a jar labeled TWO MONTHS SAVED, one pair priced TWO HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Full grain leather, stitched soles, and a lifetime repair program.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, close up of a brown leather boot with visible stitching, tags read FULL GRAIN and LIFETIME REPAIR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every three years a cobbler resoles them for sixty dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a friendly cobbler hammering a new sole onto the boot, a receipt reads SIXTY DOLLARS, a calendar reads THREE YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years later, her total is three hundred eighty dollars, one pair.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman isadora lacing the same boots, a scoreboard reads THREE HUNDRED EIGHTY, a tag reads ONE PAIR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Cost per wear, Ivan paid forty cents. Isadora paid nineteen.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a gym whiteboard with two columns, IVAN FORTY CENTS PER WEAR and ISADORA NINETEEN CENTS PER WEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Divide the price by the wears. Buy it once. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
